question: As per the Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023, digital evidence submitted in courts must be:

options.text: Supported with a valid digital signature

solution:
The correct answer is __**Supported with a valid digital signature**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• As per the **Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023**, digital evidence submitted in courts must be **authenticated and verified** to ensure its reliability and integrity.
 
• A **valid digital signature** is mandatory for submitted digital evidence, as it serves as a proof of authenticity and ensures that the evidence has not been tampered with.
 
• Digital signatures are governed under the provisions of the **Information Technology (IT) Act, 2000**, which provides a legal framework for their use in India.
 
• The requirement for a digital signature aligns with the need for **secure and accurate documentation** in legal proceedings, as digital evidence can be prone to manipulation.
 
• This measure ensures that digital submissions in court are treated with the same level of scrutiny and reliability as physical evidence.
